title: SPY 2-Day Momentum Overnight Gap — Artifact or Real?
author: [提出: 用戶, 執行: Claude]

look_ahead_diagnosis.explanation: merge_asof(direction=backward) maps TW date T to SPY date T when both markets trade on the same calendar day. But SPY closes at 4PM ET (= 5AM TST next day), which is AFTER Taiwan already traded. So using SPY(T) data for TW(T) is look-ahead bias.

verdict.bug_type: K519/K520 merge_asof used same-day SPY data (96.7% of days). This MIXED future SPY close (T) with previous SPY close (T-1). The correct signal (using only T-1 data) is STRONGER, not weaker.
verdict.key_finding: The buggy signal was ANTI-predictive because it mixed the truly-predictive SPY(T-1) with noise from SPY(T). Fixing the lag reveals the full TZ information transmission: corr(SPY_T-1, TW_gap) = 0.611
verdict.connection_to_I8: This is the SAME TZ information transmission channel documented in I8. SPY(T-1) close at 5AM TST → Taiwan gap at 9AM TST. The 4-hour window carries ~61% correlation.

implementability.spot_0050_tw: NOT implementable — cannot buy after TW close and sell at open
implementability.index_futures: POSSIBLY implementable — TW futures after-hours session 15:00-05:00, SPY closes at 05:00 TST. Window: buy at 05:01, sell at 09:00 (4 hours). But extremely tight timing.
implementability.practical_concern: Gap return is ALREADY priced in at 9AM open. The strategy 'captures' the gap but you must HOLD through the gap. You need to be positioned BEFORE the gap happens. After SPY signal is available (5AM), TW futures may already reflect it in after-hours pricing.

items: DATA BUG CONFIRMED: K519/K520 used same-day SPY data (96.7%) — merge_asof(backward) matches SPY(T) to TW(T)
REVERSE EFFECT: Fixing the bug INCREASES Sharpe from 1.076 to 4.445 (binary: 5.644)
ROOT CAUSE: Buggy signal mixed predictive SPY(T-1) with anti-predictive SPY(T), destroying the signal
THIS IS I8 TZ CHANNEL: corr(SPY_T-1, TW_gap) = 0.611, 16/16 years positive, min Sharpe 3.486
GAP-ONLY ALPHA: Gap Sharpe=5.644, Intraday Sharpe=0.453 — all alpha is in the overnight gap
IMPLEMENTATION CHALLENGE: SPY close at 5AM TST = TW futures after-hours end. Near-impossible timing.
K519 S2 INVALID: Sharpe 1.079 used wrong signal. Correct signal gives 4.445 but may not be implementable.

component_analysis.conclusion: 100% of alpha is in overnight gap; intraday has near-zero signal

implication_for_k519: K519/K520 merge_asof bug: used SPY(T) instead of SPY(T-1). This SUPPRESSED the true signal. The correct 1d signal uses SPY(T-1) return (available at 5AM TST, 4 hours before TW open). With correct lag: binary Sharpe=5.644, VT Sharpe=4.445. This is the I8 TZ information transmission channel — real but implementation-constrained. K519 Sharpe 1.079 is invalid (wrong signal), but the correct value is HIGHER, not lower. All overnight gap strategies using SPY signals need recomputation with proper lag.
